The '''OMS Devilfish sub''', also known as the '''Devilfish OSM''' or the '''Republic assault submarine''', was an [[Water/Legends|underwater]] vehicle used and distributed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was used in the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]] by the Republic, [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], and eventually the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Quarren Isolation League|forces]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] after a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] invasion engineered by [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]]. It was specifically used and introduced to the planet Dac during the initial Republic backup of the Mon Calamari forces during the unofficial Quarren threat. After the Quarren attacked under the influence of Riff Tamson, and reinforced with Separatist [[Aqua droid/Legends|aqua droids]], the Republic task force along with the rest of the Mon Calamari defenders, was defeated. After the survivors of the attack contacted the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], a [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan army]] was dispatched to Dac from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] incorporated the use of abandoned Devilfish [[Submarine/Legends|submarines]] in their attack, and, despite the fact that their counterattack was larger than the original Republic reinforcements, they too, were defeated and taken to enslavement camps. During the execution of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]], the Quarren, Mon Calamari, and Republic/Gungan forces rebelled against Riff Tamson and engineered the use of Quarren occupied submarines to defeat the aqua droids.
